## What changed and why

## How I tested it

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] a test covers the change (a bug fix has a test that failed before)
- [ ] the documentation says the same as the code (`docs/`, README)
- [ ] no book text, canon, database or personal path is added
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under "Unreleased"
